actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Short dark swept/side-parted raised hair, brows and serious restrained mouth remain in near-front pose. Blue-gray high civilian Chinese tunic, overlapping center closure and dark inner neck retained. Very fine upper-lip details are not independently resolved and are not replaced by an invented heavy moustache, beard or accessory. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Source remains Chinese CCP related archive-only, prohibited from final mod payload; its art gap is not a release blocker. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.
